premise.claim: Docs PR: `replicas` can be updated in place on CacheRuntime Master and Worker (synced to the AdvancedStatefulSet on every reconcile), contradicting the previous docs that listed `replicas` as requiring a redeploy.
premise.patchedComponent: docs/{en,zh}/samples/cacheruntime/cacheruntime_spec_update.md (+ stale TODO comment removed from sync.go)
premise.evidence: syncRuntimeSpec passes &runtime.Spec.{Master,Worker}.Replicas (always non-nil) into ComponentSpec; SyncComponentSpec applies it first via updateReplicas and patches the ASTS when the value differs. Proven by the fake-client harness running the real code path. See results/L1-replicas-sync.txt.

findings.desc: spec.worker.replicas is synced in place to the Worker ASTS (doc 3.3)
spec.master.replicas is synced in place to the Master ASTS (doc summary table)
scale-in (2->1) is propagated, not just scale-out
sync is value-driven/idempotent: unchanged replicas produce no spurious patch

staticClaims.desc: Scaling is silent: no RuntimeCondition, no Event on this path (unlike pkg/ctrl/replicas.go SyncReplicas)
staticClaims.how: grep: syncRuntimeSpec/SyncComponentSpec/updateReplicas emit no recorder.Event and no UpdateRuntimeCondition; SyncReplicas emits RuntimeWorkerScaledIn/Out + Events

staticClaims.desc: Scaling in discards cached data (no drain/migration)
staticClaims.how: grep -niE 'scaledown|drain|migrat|preStop' pkg/ddc/cache finds only unrelated DataMigrate CRD code; ASTS scale-down deletes pods with no cache handoff. Inferred, matches author's own note.

staticClaims.desc: replicas is not subject to the cgroupv1 step-by-step limitation
staticClaims.how: The cgroupv1 constraint (K8s #127356) is about resizing image+resources simultaneously; replicas touches neither container image nor resources.

staticClaims.desc: Section 4 'any field not in section 3' is exhaustive
staticClaims.how: SyncComponentSpec updates exactly {replicas, image(runtimeVersion), resources} = the three subsections of section 3.

staticClaims.desc: kubectl logs -n fluid-system deploy/cacheruntime-controller | grep 'replicas changed' works
staticClaims.how: charts/fluid/fluid/templates/controller/cacheruntime_controller.yaml defines a Deployment named cacheruntime-controller in the fluid namespace; 'replicas changed, will update' is logged at Info level (advanced_statefulset_manager.go:263)

liveNote: L3 (live) intentionally skipped: the claim is fully decided at L1 by running the real syncRuntimeSpec code path against a fake client.
